apps.name: OmaRaptor Player
apps.description: A free, super-light player for almost any video link, with a working HUD inspired by the F-22 Raptor. Copy a link, press Super+Alt+Y, and it plays in a pinned 16:9 window.
notes: CRUISE is a bare player, COMBAT is the full cockpit. Live time, seek, volume and audio-signal gauges, keyboard first, many players at once. mpv and yt-dlp underneath, no login and no browser.
Demo footage: Falcon Heavy / Roman Space Telescope launch drone video, SpaceX (CC0) via NASA, and launch high-speed footage, NASA/Cory S Huston (public domain).
Unofficial fan project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. Air Force, Lockheed Martin, SpaceX or NASA.

shots.alt: OmaRaptor Player in fullscreen COMBAT mode: the scope locked on the rocket, heading tape, VOL and REM tapes and the control bar.
The MASTER ARM panel, switching between CRUISE and COMBAT over launch footage.
End of video: the timers turn amber and red and a NEXT card shows what plays next.
Small, medium and large OmaRaptor players side by side.
The keyboard and mouse panel that opens with the ? key.

apps.name: Oma Year Planner
apps.description: Your whole year on one screen. A local-first year calendar for Omarchy, with no backend, no account and no build step.

apps.name: Kar Page Launcher
apps.description: Kar Page as a desktop app on Omarchy. It adds a launcher entry and an icon, and opens karpage.app in its own Chromium app window.
apps.install: git clone https://github.com/KarPage/karpage-omarchy.git && cd karpage-omarchy && less install && ./install
notes: The install script is short and readable. The command below opens it in less before it runs.

apps.name: OmaKarDash
apps.description: A Tesla dashboard for Omarchy: charge and range, climate, tires, lock state and software updates.
notes: It will use each owner's own Tesla developer app, read Tesla's cached data without waking the car, and ask for a confirm on every command. No unlock, no location and no remote start.
Preview screenshots use demo data for a fictional car. Unofficial. Not affiliated with Tesla.
